statements.body: I served as Principal Distributed Systems Architect at Nexus Corp from March 2021 to December 2023. During this tenure, I independently designed and executed the 100k QPS low-latency ledger migration. Prior to that, I left my previous employer in January 2021.

claims.source_quote: I served as Principal Distributed Systems Architect at Nexus Corp from March 2021 to December 2023.

evidence.description: Ledger migration RFC #118 authors: Marcus Vance (Tech Lead) and Team of 6 engineers; Elena Rostova listed as secondary code reviewer.
Nexus Corp SEC filing: Ledger migration completed Q3 2022 under Infrastructure Platform team.

findings.explanation: Attribution discrepancy: Candidate claims to have 'independently designed and executed' the ledger migration, but repository audit records show RFC author was Tech Lead Marcus Vance and Candidate was reviewer.

coachQuestion.question: Can you walk through the division of engineering responsibilities between yourself and the team on the low-latency ledger migration project?
coachQuestion.reason: Examine candidate scope of ownership neutrally without accusing them of misrepresenting contributions.
